description: IBM Verify claim shape, scalar-tolerant. Covers sub, roles, teams then groups, and permissions then scope for a subject; client_id / azp as the client anchor, client_name, authorized_scopes then scope, aud, and roles for a client. These arrive as tenant-provisioned custom attributes mapped by CELx mappers rather than as Verify defaults, so the claim names are the ones a tenant declares. Exists because Verify emits collection claims as bare scalars at N=1, and the built-in Rust mapper reads them with an array accessor that yields nothing for a JSON string, leaving the field empty with no error and presenting as a policy deny rather than the config fault it is. The custom collection candidates therefore take a string as one value as well as an array, which lets the tenant drop the trailing empty-string pad it used to append to force array shape, a pad that made "" a real set member in audit records and X-Policy-* output. Reading an unpadded tenant without this preset reintroduces the silent empty, and narrowing these candidates back to array-only does the same. Deliberately omitted: a workload section, because Verify mints no SPIFFE shape and role: workload against this preset fails at load naming the role; and gh_permissions and manager, because policy reads those as raw claims rather than structured fields, manager in particular being a scalar userName from the SCIM EnterpriseUser relationship that CIBA takes as a login_hint and that an array would break.
